name: Maaseiah
description: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: In the eighteenth year of his reign, when he has purged the land and the house, Josiah sends Shaphan, Maaseiah, and Joah to repair the house of the Lord his God.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 34: Josiah the Wise Child Finds the Book of the Law
